topic: The boring business playbook nobody talks about
angle: Three unsexy businesses quietly hitting $10K/month while everyone chases dropshipping.
hook: 3 boring businesses quietly hitting $10K/month while everyone chases dropshipping
caption:
The reels sell you dropshipping and crypto. Meanwhile three specific boring businesses are quietly minting operators. None require ads. None require inventory. All require operations, not creativity. This is not romantic. It is what actually works. Which of these three would you consider running?

slides.title: Pick the one you actually respect
slides.body: You will grind for 12 months. Pick the business you can stomach that long. Vending is the easiest solo start. Laundromats scale fastest.

slides.text: The wealthy in every city own boring businesses. The reels never show them because they are not sexy.
